add_device.title: Configure Xiaoling MCP endpoint
add_device.description: Enter the pairing code from the Xiaoling mini program and select the MCP Servers to expose. After pairing, this device connects its own MCP Connector.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Xiaoling MCP service
error.invalid_auth: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used
error.llm_api_required: Select at least one MCP Server
error.invalid_llm_api: The selected MCP Server is unavailable
error.api_error: The Xiaoling MCP service returned an error
error.connector_limit: This device already has the maximum number of connectors. Revoke an unused binding in the mini program first.
